messages:
anya: Opening a small PR to add very short anonymized audit-log examples + SDK snippets (Node, Go, curl) and a one-sentence retention note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7531
mike: Sounds good. Keep snippets under 6 lines. Add a tiny pseudonymization example and a line that clarifies what telemetry is fine to send (model-id, event-type, latency). Also call out env var REDWOOD_AUDIT_URL.
jamal: I can add Node + curl. Plan to show pseudonymized user_id and an email hash placeholder. Won't recommend any specific hashing lib.
lucy: I'll add the TTL vs legal hold sentence under retention and cross-link to the compliance playbook. Short and to the point.
sara (Legal): Quick guidance: avoid the word "delete" for compliance docs. Prefer "redact" or "pseudonymize." Include: "Retention TTLs apply unless overridden by a documented legal hold; PII should be redacted or pseudonymized." I'll review the PR once text is in.
anya: Assigning: jamal (snippets), lucy (retention sentence + link), mike (final small edit + merge after legal OK), sara (legal signoff). Target: merge by EOD tomorrow.
mike: One micro-ask: show a telemetry example payload that only contains non-PII fields and the pseudonymized id separately. Example env var name again: REDWOOD_AUDIT_URL.
jamal: Draft Node snippet (will paste into PR):
```js
// Node pseudonymized audit example
const url = process.env.REDWOOD_AUDIT_URL;
const payload = { event: 'generate', model_id: 'rdw-ggml-v1', user_id: 'pseudonym_xyz', latency_ms: 120 };
fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
```
mike: Nice. Change user_id example so it doesn't imply reversible mapping (pseudonym_xyz is good).
lucy: Retention sentence I'm adding: "Retention TTLs apply unless overridden by a documented legal hold; PII must be redacted or pseudonymized before export." I'll add a link to the compliance playbook below that line.
sara (Legal): LGTM. Tiny edit: prefer "redact or pseudonymize" (that order). Also add a short note to avoid verb "delete" in examples.
jamal: Quick Go snippet (one line) for the PR:
```go
// Go pseudonymized audit example (pseudo)
payload := []byte(`{"event":"generate","user_id":"pseudonym_xyz"}`)
http.Post(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_AUDIT_URL"), "application/json", bytes.NewBuffer(payload))
```
anya: Docs-bot, can you post a preview once PR is up?
docs-bot: Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.com/pr/7531 (expires in 7 days)
mike: I'll add a short note in the PR description: "Examples are intentionally minimal; do not interpret as production-ready crypto. Use vetted libs for hashing in production." Also call out compliance playbook link.
sara (Legal): I'll give final signoff inline after the wording edits.
anya: Great. Checklist in PR description: short examples, no vendor libs, link to compliance playbook, legal signoff required. Assigning now and pushing a tiny WIP commit.
